items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I'm in the process now of studying with Hale Smith

ctx.x: So I'm in the process of doing that now, and actually it's a new experience for me in writing because I knew it was a big assignment but just like I said I can't say no and I think that well I'd better go to the horse's mouth and find out what to do so I'm in the process now of studying with Hale Smith who's assistant director of music at the University of Connecticut. And he's actually a great symphony writer. So I told Hale, I said, Hale, I took on this assignment and I really don't know nothing about…
You've been saying that all your life, haven't you.
